snippet.title: Star of Providence - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play now on Nintendo Switch & Steam (update free for game owners)! Descend into the facility and seek out power eternal in this roguelike shoot em up masterpiece! Engage in pulse pounding battles in an ever shifting gauntlet loaded with oncoming bullets and game changing powerups!
Nintendo eShop- https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-of-providence-switch/
Steam- https://store.steampowered.com/app/603960/Star_of_Providence/
